titles: 동물원에서 가장 많이 탈출한 동물은? (feat. 머리 좋으면 잘 나갈까?)
동물원 탈출 1위는 원숭이가 아니었다 (feat. 뉴스엔 왜 맹수만?)
늑대 늑구는 어떻게 동물원을 나왔을까 (feat. 탈출 1위는 따로 있다?)

image_concepts.A: D 내려다보기 + C 스케일 비틀기(추천 · 문구 1·2용). 손바닥만 한 미니어처 동물원을 위에서 내려다본 장면 — 우리 안의 원숭이·사자는 그대로 위를 올려다보고, 새 떼만 주황 빛 띠를 그리며 동물원 밖으로 흘러 나간다.
image_concepts.B: G 결정적 순간(문구 1·3용). 철창을 움켜쥔 의기양양한 원숭이 위로, 폭풍 치는 밤하늘에 분홍 플라밍고가 날아오르는 순간.

edits: 날아가는 새 떼에 빨간 손그림 동그라미 + 흰 손글씨 「거의 절반」 (호주 140년 기록 46%)
플라밍고에 빨간 화살표 + 흰 손글씨 「17년 뒤 텍사스에서」 (캔자스 플라밍고 492, 2005→2022 목격)
meta.note: 반실사 일러스트. 장면 유형 D+C · G · 좌우 분할 · E · A-2 단면 컷어웨이(2026-10-15 규칙, 벌꿀오소리 유머 컷 교체 — 대본에 없는 동물이었음). 단면 계열 1개. 사살·총·피·부상 장면 금지, 실존 인물 없음

thumbnails.concept_ko: A 내려다보기 + 스케일 비틀기(추천). 손바닥만 한 미니어처 동물원을 위에서 내려다본 장면 — 원숭이 우리·사자 우리 안의 동물은 위를 올려다보고, 조류장 한쪽에서 새 떼만 주황 빛 띠를 그리며 담 밖으로 흘러 나간다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A high bird's-eye view of a detailed miniature zoo, small enough to look like a tabletop model, filling the upper part of the frame: green lawns, winding paths, a monkey enclosure, a lion enclosure and a tall mesh aviary. Inside their enclosures a monkey and a lion stand still and look straight up, while from the aviary a long flock of small colorful birds streams out over the outer wall, their path drawn as a glowing warm orange ribbon curving away into a teal sky. Curious, slightly humorous mood. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: B 결정적 순간. 화면 앞쪽에 철창을 두 손으로 움켜쥔 채 의기양양한 원숭이, 그 위로 폭풍 치는 밤하늘에 빗줄기를 뚫고 분홍 플라밍고 한 마리가 날개를 펴고 날아오르는 순간 (대본: 2005년 6월 폭풍 치던 밤 492번이 날아감).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. In the foreground, a monkey grips the bars of its zoo enclosure with both hands and puts on a smug, confident expression, as if it were the great escape artist. Above and behind it, on a stormy night with dark teal storm clouds and slanting streaks of rain, a bright pink flamingo with wings spread wide is caught at the exact moment it lifts off into the night sky, lit warm orange by the zoo's lamps below. The monkey has not noticed the flamingo. Playful, surprising mood with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: A 좌우 분할(문구 3용). 왼쪽 절반은 도시 차도 한가운데를 달리는 얼룩말과 멈춰 선 차들(뉴스가 되는 탈출), 오른쪽 절반은 조용한 동물원 조류장 지붕 그물의 작은 틈으로 작은 새 한 마리가 아무도 모르게 빠져나가는 장면(장부에만 남는 탈출).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A split composition divided vertically down the middle. On the left half, a zebra gallops down the middle of a busy Korean city road between stopped cars and apartment buildings, dramatic and loud, lit in warm orange. On the right half, a calm, quiet zoo aviary under soft teal light, where one small colorful bird slips silently out through a tiny gap in the roof netting while no one notices. The contrast between the noisy left scene and the silent right scene is the focus. Intriguing, curious mood. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No people's faces, no text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: B 투명 투시(문구 2용). 거대한 돔형 조류장을 반투명하게 그려 안의 새들이 보이고, 지붕 그물 한 칸이 느슨하게 벌어진 자리로 홍학·앵무 몇 마리가 줄지어 빠져나간다. 아래 구석에 작은 사육사가 그물채를 들고 올려다본다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A huge dome-shaped zoo aviary drawn semi-transparent like a glass model, so the many colorful birds inside are visible, filling the upper two thirds of the frame. At the very top, one panel of the roof mesh has come loose and bulges open, and a short line of pink flamingos and bright green parrots is flying out through that gap into the teal sky, the opening glowing warm orange. In a lower corner, a tiny zookeeper seen from behind holds a long-handled net and looks up. Curious, lightly comic mood. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: A-2 단면 컷어웨이. 늑대 방사장을 칼로 자른 단면 — 철조망 아래 흙 속으로 굴 하나가 철조망 밑을 지나 바깥으로 이어지고, 굴 끝에서 늑대 한 마리가 막 빠져나오는 순간 (대본: 늑구는 사파리 철조망 아래 흙을 파고 나감)

A detailed cutaway cross-section view revealing the interior of a wolf enclosure at a Korean safari park, sliced open like a clean textbook diagram and filling the upper 60% of the frame. Above ground, a tall chain-link wire fence stands on the ground. Below the surface, the cut shows plain brown soil under the fence, and one single narrow tunnel dug through the soil beneath the fence line, leading from inside the enclosure to the outside.
